task_completion.description: Open the Subsurface Preferences or Settings window.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog window titled 'Preferences' or 'Subsurface Preferences' is visible over the main application.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Dive Computer' or 'Deco' settings tab where Gradient Factors are configured.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Preferences window shows the 'Dive Computer' or 'Deco' tab selected, revealing GF Low and GF High input fields.

task_completion.description: Set GF Low to 30% and GF High to 70%.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The input fields for 'GF Low' show the value '30' and 'GF High' show the value '70'.

task_completion.description: Set Bottom SAC to 20 L/min and Deco SAC to 17 L/min.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The input fields for 'Bottom SAC' (or 'SAC') show '20' and 'Deco SAC' show '17'. Note: These may be in a 'Rates' or 'General' sub-tab within Preferences.

task_completion.description: Apply the settings and save the dive log to persist changes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user clicks 'OK' or 'Apply' in the Preferences window, and subsequently clicks 'File' > 'Save' or the Save icon in the main toolbar.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to edit the configuration file directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: No terminal window is seen executing 'sed', 'echo', or text editors on the Subsurface.conf file.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Subsurface GUI elements to change values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor or focus indicators on the specific text boxes for GF and SAC values.

integrity.description: The agent used the actual Subsurface application interface rather than just simulating a save.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application window is active and responsive throughout the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required values are: GF Low = 30, GF High = 70, Bottom SAC = 20 L/min, and Deco SAC = 17 L/min. These settings are typically found in the Preferences menu under 'Dive Computer' or 'Rates'. The task is only complete if the agent saves the file (File > Save) after applying the settings.
